# WebWatcher

> WebWatcher is a free, open-source (MIT) macOS menu bar app that watches badges, counters, text and Gmail senders you would otherwise refresh by hand, and sends a native notification when they change. It reads your existing Safari sessions (no re-login), runs locally, and has no account or server.

- Requires macOS 13+, Apple Silicon. Developer ID signed and notarized DMG, about 3 MB.
- Watch any element via CSS selector or XPath, with a guided picker in Safari; notifies only on change; check interval 15 seconds to 30 minutes.
- Gmail sender and domain watchers (OAuth, read-only), custom notification icon, title and body, optional Herald delivery.
